title: CRREM Technical Blueprint — Asset Input
description: Input data model for a single asset in a CRREM-aligned assessment tool. Every required field must be present. Conditional fields apply based on Country (Postal_Code for USA/CAN/AUS) and Property_Type (MU_* for Mixed Use).

GAV.description: Gross Asset Value. Not used in intensity calculations. Must be entered in a consistent currency across all assets in a portfolio.

Country.description: Country name. Must match Pathways and Emission Factors sheets exactly. For USA, Canada, Australia, Country alone is not sufficient — Postal_Code is also required.

Postal_Code.description: Required only for countries with sub-national pathways (USA, CAN, AUS). Store as text to preserve leading zeros. Resolved via Postal Code Lookup in Step 5.1.

Property_Type.description: One of the canonical CRREM property types, or 'Mixed Use'. See Property Types & Definitions reference.

GIA.description: Gross Internal Area. Denominator for all intensity calculations. Must be > 0. Excludes indoor parking.

Reporting_Year.description: Year the consumption data refers to. Must exist as a column in Pathways and Emission Factors datasets.

Gas.description: Natural gas consumption. Enter 0 if unused.

Renew_Consumed.description: On-site renewable energy generated AND consumed on-site. EF = 0 for carbon. Counts toward Total_Energy.

Renew_Exported.description: On-site renewable energy exported to grid. NOT in Total_Energy. Used only for grid export credit in Step 4, capped at CO2_Elec.

^MU_[A-Za-z_]+_Pct$.description: Floor-area share per use type. All MU_*_Pct must sum to 100 when Property_Type = 'Mixed Use'.

formulaGraph.formula: Total_Energy = Elec_Grid + Gas + Oil + District_Heating + District_Cooling + Biomass + Other_Fuels + Renew_Consumed

formulaGraph.notes: Key output. Compared against CRREM EUI pathway in Step 6.
Apply per carrier. CO2_Renew = Renew_Consumed * 0 (hard-coded EF=0). EF_Electricity varies per country × Reporting_Year.
CRITICAL: capped at grid electricity emissions. Cannot offset gas/oil/DH with surplus solar export.
Key output. Compared against CRREM CO2 pathway in Step 6.
For USA/CAN/AUS, CRREM_Region resolved from Postal_Code via Postal Code Lookup. Otherwise CRREM_Region = Country.

formulaGraph.formula: Blended_Pathway(t) = SUM_over_i( MU_Pct[i] * Pathway(Country, Type[i], t) )
formulaGraph.notes: CRITICAL: recompute for every year t separately — component pathways decline at different rates.

formulaGraph.formula: Carbon_Intensity(t) = (CO2(t) - Grid_Export_Credit(t)) / GIA, where CO2(t) uses EF_Elec(t) and all other EFs constant
formulaGraph.notes: Forward projection: demand held constant, grid EFs decline per Emission Factors dataset.

formulaGraph.formula: Total_Energy(t) = Energy_Heating * HDD_Ratio(t) + Energy_Cooling * CDD_Ratio(t) + Energy_Baseload
formulaGraph.notes: OPTIONAL. Replaces flat-demand assumption when HDD/CDD projections are supplied. Requires SSP scenario choice.

formulaGraph.formula: CO2_Misalignment_Year = first t in [Reporting_Year, 2050] where Carbon_Intensity(t) > CO2_Pathway(t)
formulaGraph.notes: Key output. Report Reporting_Year if already misaligned, or 'Beyond 2050' if no crossing.
Key output. Equivalent to SUM(Net_CO2_j) / SUM(GIA_j) at reporting year.

formulaGraph.formula: Portfolio_CO2_Pathway(t) = SUM_over_j( GIA_Weight_j * CO2_Pathway_j(t) ) for each t in 2020..2050
formulaGraph.notes: Full time series. Declines year by year.

formulaGraph.formula: Portfolio_CO2_Misalignment_Year = first t where Portfolio_Carbon_Intensity(t) > Portfolio_CO2_Pathway(t)

edgeCases.title: Grid export credit cap
edgeCases.body: Credit for exported on-site renewables is capped at grid electricity emissions. You cannot offset gas, oil, or district heating emissions with surplus solar export.

edgeCases.title: Mixed-use pathway blending
edgeCases.body: For mixed-use buildings there is no single pathway row. Compute a floor-area-weighted blend of the per-use pathways, separately for every year from 2020 to 2050.
edgeCases.formula: Blended_Pathway(t) = SUM_over_i( MU_Pct[i] * Pathway(Country, Type[i], t) )

edgeCases.title: Renew_Consumed counts for EUI, not CO2
edgeCases.body: On-site renewables consumed on-site are real energy consumption and are included in Total_Energy. Their emission factor is 0, so they do not affect Carbon_Intensity. This asymmetry is by design.

edgeCases.title: District heating/cooling EF — legacy fallback
edgeCases.body: If no site-specific EF is supplied, the legacy fallback scales the UK default (0.20431) against the local grid trajectory.

edgeCases.title: Climate-adjusted EUI projection (HDD/CDD)
edgeCases.body: Default is flat demand. If HDD/CDD projections are supplied, scale heating and cooling shares of energy separately.
edgeCases.formula: Total_Energy(t) = Energy_Heating * HDD_Ratio(t) + Energy_Cooling * CDD_Ratio(t) + Energy_Baseload

edgeCases.title: Forward projection basis
edgeCases.body: Energy demand held constant. Grid EFs decline annually per the Emission Factors dataset. All other EFs are constant (exception: DH/DC legacy fallback follows the grid trajectory). This produces a year-by-year declining Carbon_Intensity curve even without retrofits.
